items.source: locale - the Locale used for formatting
items.translation: locale - 用于格式化的区域设置

items.source: Default is false: Messages without arguments are by default returned as-is, without parsing them through MessageFormat. Set this to true to enforce MessageFormat for all messages, expecting all message texts to be written with MessageFormat escaping.
items.translation: 默认值为 `false`：不带参数的消息默认原样返回，不通过 `MessageFormat` 进行解析。将此值设置为 `true` 可强制对所有消息使用 `MessageFormat`，预期所有消息文本均使用 `MessageFormat` 转义编写。

items.source: For example, MessageFormat expects a single quote to be escaped as two adjacent single quotes ("''"). If your message texts are all written with such escaping, even when not defining argument placeholders, you need to set this flag to true. Otherwise, only message texts with actual arguments are supposed to be written with MessageFormat escaping.
items.translation: 例如，MessageFormat 期望将单个引号转义为两个相邻的单引号 ("''")。如果您的消息文本均使用此类转义方式编写（即使未定义参数占位符），则需要将此标志设置为 true。否则，只有包含实际参数的消息文本才应使用 MessageFormat 转义。

items.source: AbstractMessageSource derives from this class, providing concrete getMessage implementations that delegate to a central template method for message code resolution.
items.translation: AbstractMessageSource 继承自该类，提供具体的 getMessage 实现，这些实现委托给中央模板方法以解析消息代码。

items.source: The default implementation passes the String to formatMessage, resolving any argument placeholders found in them. Subclasses may override this method to plug in custom processing of default messages.
items.translation: 默认实现将 `String` 传递给 `formatMessage`，解析其中找到的任何参数占位符。子类可以重写此方法以自定义默认消息的处理方式。

items.source:
The default implementation simply returns the given argument array as-is.
Can be overridden in subclasses in order to resolve special argument types.
items.translation: 默认实现直接返回给定的参数数组。可在子类中重写该方法，以解析特殊的参数类型。

items.source: Return whether to always apply the MessageFormat rules, parsing even messages without arguments.
items.translation: 返回是否始终应用 `MessageFormat` 规则，即使解析不带参数的消息。

items.source:
Format the given message String, using cached MessageFormats.
By default invoked for passed-in default messages, to resolve
any argument placeholders found in them.
items.translation: 使用缓存的 MessageFormats 格式化给定的消息 String。默认情况下，此方法用于解析传入的默认消息中的任何参数占位符。
